verdict.rationale: Signifyd publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for its v3 API at a stable JSON URL, linked from the reference introduction, so the core story is met with a standard machine-readable spec. Discovery is slightly awkward because the ReadMe UI download button is disabled and the spec is reached only through a prose link. missing for 10: in-UI download button, independent or hands-on corroboration that the spec is complete and valid.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
